facts.fact: A note in the salve pot, a week before tonight, asked Eravi how many the Resin House holds and on which day the pages go back. Eravi asked Neela (ch 22), got no answer, and wrote that he did not know; Chathu does not have the reading day.

Devan orders Bhaskaran to send his best rider to Vasu at the Resin House at first light, because the wood road cannot be ridden by night; the horse is saddled in the yard when Vasu arrives first, so the warning is too late.
Bhaskaran rode back from the Resin House with Devan that morning; Vasu leads the six men left there.
